clue.text: Medieval weapon, one prominent on breakfast TV?

definitions.meaning: a spiked club or mace of the Middle Ages bore this celestial name
a celebrity presenter of early-day television, read whimsically as a dawn celebrity

explanation.surface: A quiz pairing an old battle mace with a celebrity of the breakfast sofa.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the playful second reading: a big name on a breakfast show is a 'star' of the morning.
explanation.definitionFit: The spiked mace of medieval warfare is named after Venus, the bright planet seen before dawn.

clue.text: Size of each square oddly checked by the setter

explanation.definitionFit: To size something up is to gauge its dimensions, which is a synonym of the verb here.

clue.text: Backed well-informed European visiting Irish broadcaster to find fame

clue.text: Type of action from Democrat to interrupt current American hearing

clue.text: Stare when wife takes male's place with umbrella

clue.text: Points I've allowed to be raised in broadcast

taken as written, without the apostrophe

explanation.walkthrough: ESIVELET read upwards gives the answer.

clue.text: Van leaving area bears sign of corrosion, it's whispered

clue.text: Actor, upset on Sunday, occasionally lost temper

only every other letter of the day's name is used

explanation.walkthrough: SNA (alternate letters of 'Sunday') then PPED (DEPP reversed). 'Occasionally' looks like part of the definition but picks letters.

clue.text: Obsequious City chap son sacked

clue.text: City attracts English talent up front, that's firmly established

clue.text: Slim Scandinavian, typically, almost reaching officer grade at last

the name stops short of its final letter

explanation.walkthrough: SVE (SVEN cut short) plus LT plus E, the last letter of 'grade'.
explanation.definitionFit: Slender and elegant: both describe a trim figure, so they are synonyms.

clue.text: Venetian songs Fletcher and Arkwright possibly heard

clue.text: Excuse source of gratification when half-cut

explanation.definitionFit: A plea in mitigation offers a justification, so it works as a synonym for a pretext or apology.

clue.text: Verbal attacks coming from verge of motorway maybe between discontented bikers

with no contents, only the outer letters of the word bikers remain

clue.text: Intimidating, big-serving male tennis players?

acing means serving unreturnable aces

clue.text: Vegetable adding flavour if cooking mostly pea broth

clue.text: Drop rent

a rip or split in fabric

explanation.definitionFit: One spelling, two pronunciations: a falling droplet when crying, and a split in cloth.
